question: The length of the badminton court for singles is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**13.40 m.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badminton:-**

 
 
• It is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• Badminton is often played as a casual outdoor activity in a yard or on a beach; formal games are played on a rectangular indoor court.
 
• Points are scored by striking the shuttlecock with the racquet and landing it within the other team's half of the court.
 
 
 
• **Badminton courts:-**
 
 
• It's ​**width** for singles is 5.18 m and for doubles it is 6.1 m.
 
• The badminton net is placed at the **center of the court,** and its height is **1.55 meters **from the ground level.
 
• The court's lines are **40mm wide **and are considered inside the court's measurements.
 
• The badminton court's overall area is 87.4 square meters, and it is divided into two equal halves for singles and doubles games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here is a list of the names of badminton cups:
 
 
• **Thomas Cup**: International men's team badminton championship
 
• **Uber Cup**: International women's team badminton championship
 
• **Sudirman Cup**: International mixed team badminton championship
 
• **BWF World Championships**: Individual badminton championship featuring singles, doubles, and mixed doubles
 
• **BWF World Junior Championships: **Individual badminton championship for players under the age of 19
 
• **BWF World Senior Championships:** Individual badminton championship for players over the age of 35
 
• BWF World Tour Super 1000, Super 750, Super 500, and Super 300 tournaments: Series of badminton tournaments held throughout the year
